A.desc: the original array (the FM chime with the hard-chop friction), level-matched: a reference

B.desc: the clean base, a ring of about 2 s: AMP DECAY 102, release 102

C.desc: a ring of about 4 s, a slow shimmer (TRI 0.37 Hz, pitch +-9.4 cents, amp 20, delay 35)

D.desc: a ring of about 6 s, the shimmer, more space (MIX 45, DRAIN 35)

Xopen.desc: calibration on C: the filter held open (FILTER SUSTAIN 100, DECAY 127, ENV AMT 100, CUTOFF 95): the tail keeps its top end instead of darkening

Yrise.desc: calibration on C: the filter opens slowly while the ring decays (CUTOFF 70, ENV AMT 120, FILTER ATTACK 95, SUSTAIN 127): a dark strike, a bright tail
